author: Stealthbomber16
body:
Welcome to the world of the Ancients! Here you will find your personality, here you will find who you are, and what your belonging is.

Would you be Radiant? A protector of all that is good and just? Nurturer of the forest? Or would you be Dire? An evil, animalistic corrupter, bent on making the world yours? As the sides grow weary, a war breaks out. There is nowhere to run, nowhere to hide. Any strategy works.

Use caves to go into the enemies base from the side, where they can't enter, but you can.

Harness Camouflage and hide in the terrain!

Strategize! Knock people into areas that kill them, or give you an advantage!

Anything goes in this Team vs Team showdown, where the terrain means a lot. Use it to your advantage.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
My Nexus map is nearing completion! It will be my first one, and I'm really excited to release it.
No doubt, it will be my best map yet. (Ha ha. Stupid jokes.)
I still have a few things to touch up on, such as making the world EVEN MOOOOOORE void and adding more buildings. The map will be a bit different from the teaser I posted on my channel.
I have most of the YML done, (Yay!) I just have to add one more thing then I should be done with that.

Have a happy summer

You can watch a teaser at this link.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o1_hXyrpjv4&feature=youtu.be

replies.author: Mantercmg
replies.body:
No offense, but the teaser lacked... life. Even a bit of music would have made it better. (I ironically listened to two steps from hell - the protectors of earth while watching the teaser.)
And for the map, it needs for of an uneven terrain. I like the no void idea, but the map needs for bumbs, as the playable area is very flat. Other that, Good map

And thank you for the feedback for the map, I kinda agree now that I'm focusing on that, it looks a bit plain.
